The weather was sunny that day. Jack spent the weekend at the gym. Last Saturday, Jack and Anna went to the spring market. I was scared when the oil in the pan jumped.
Jack bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. Jack learned a lot about music. Anna is interested in singing. In fact, between tea and coffee, I prefer the latter.
Jack hopes to visit Xi'an one day. There are always many people at the dragon boat river. It takes twenty minutes to get to the spring market by bike. In fact, grate the cheese over the pasta.
Jack plays baseball with Anna every Saturday. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. The spring market is one of the best places in the city.
